title: Portfolio Website 2026
role: End-to-end design, publishing, architecture, and frontend development
introduction: A Nuxt 3 portfolio designed to present professional experience and frontend capabilities through a consistent information architecture. It combines semantic HTML and SCSS with Vue components, state management, and bilingual content architecture for efficient expansion and maintenance.
myWorks: Published the home, gallery, and detail pages around semantic HTML and SCSS
Used Vue templates, props, v-if, v-for, and Teleport for repeated UI and the mobile menu
Centralized Korean and English UI copy and project content in i18n/ko.json and i18n/en.json
Used Nuxt file-based routing and the Vite bundle environment for a static portfolio
Organized color, spacing, typography, radii, and shadows as SCSS design tokens
Removed unused motion, stores, and components to keep the screen code close to HTML
Prepared static deployment around the GitHub Pages base path and public asset paths
achievements: Handled the full process independently from design and publishing to architecture and frontend development
Centralized client, personal, Korean, and English content in i18n JSON files for efficient content management
Kept only essential language and theme state with Nuxt useState
Removed unused GSAP and Pinia dependencies together with motion and dialog code
Kept the structure focused on active components to improve maintainability and code readability
points: Korean and English content in JSON
Asset and path setup for static hosting
